credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Ouida Ball and Georgia O'Keeffe looking at rocks in Mike Harding's hand.  A deer skull and a white sack are at their feet. Ball and Harding are dressed in shorts and O'Keeffe is wearing  a white headscarf jacket and skirt. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Ouida Ball, Mike Harding, and Georgia O'Keeffe
